raw:
Jenson Button won 6 Grands Prix driving for McLaren between 2010 and 2025. His McLaren years were 2010–2016, and the retrieved race reports show him winning these six:

1. 2010 Australian Grand Prix
2. 2011 Canadian Grand Prix
3. 2011 Hungarian Grand Prix
4. 2011 Japanese Grand Prix
5. 2012 Australian Grand Prix
6. 2012 Brazilian Grand Prix

I checked the other McLaren-era races I could find (2010 Canada, Malaysia, Spain, Europe, Britain, Germany, Brazil; 2011 Turkey, Germany, Monaco, Australia, Abu Dhabi; 2012 Canada, Hungary, Italy, Europe, Britain, Germany, India), and Button finished no higher than second in them. I did not check every race from 2013 to 2016 individually. Those seasons produced no wins for him in my searches, but this count rests on the reports I retrieved rather than an exhaustive check. He also won races for Brawn and BAR/Honda, which don't count here.

ANSWER: 6
